author: Julijulig

title: Perfect app for me!
body: Great  app! Fell in love immediately! Just what I was looking for, simple, and not overwhelming, and price for full version is very nice and not subscription, wich is amazing, bought once and enjoying forever !  Thank you developers! Music, visuals are beautiful and calming) I would love to see some special scheduled task, like a planner, or tasks for specific day, not only habits. But maybe its too much to ask) anyway! Eden is an amazing app, looking forward to grow my garden)
author: OlenaTolm

title: April-Update 2023
body: So sehr gelungen 💝 liebevoll gemacht. Übersichtlich, nicht überladen und individuell einstellbar. Ich nutze diese App in der Vollversion fast täglich und bin begeistert. Fehlerfrei, das Geld unbedingt wert. 🙏 Danke
author: Liane HexenBär

title: tolle app
body: finde sie sehr schön gestalten und auch wenn man kein premium hat kann man sehr viel damit anfangen. Würde sie weiterempfehlen!

title: Getting more and more expensive
body: In summer I bought this app for almost 7€ and had full functionality.. now they want me to also pay for premium to use the same features.. gorgeous app but not worth that amount of money
